title: Tickets, swimming and songs
text:
A ticket system for bug reports, reflective water, real swimming, a song bar for Bards and a long list of fixes to clicking and the camera.

✨ Report a bug now creates a ticket instead of an email. Game Masters open the ticket list with /tickets (or the Tickets button in the GM tools): claim a ticket, add notes, teleport to where it happened and close it with a reply that reaches the player in game
✨ Bard songs have their own song bar above the action bar (Shift+1, 2 and 3), like stances. The glowing slot is the song you are singing
✨ Three new Bard abilities: Healing Ballad (level 2), Thunder Note (level 5) and Lullaby (level 9)
⬆️ Ability tooltips show your real numbers (damage, healing, shields, song strength, durations and cooldowns) and update as soon as you pick talents
✨ Water reflects the sky, sun and clouds, and the Hearthmere fountain has clear, rippling, reflective water
🔧 Small puddles no longer make you swim or float. You wade through them instead, and only real lakes and rivers are deep enough to swim in
⬆️ Swimming is a proper front crawl with a flutter kick, and heroes glide smoothly up and down steps, bridges and riverbanks instead of popping
🔧 Clicking no longer picks monsters that are far away or hidden behind houses and walls. Clicking a building or the ground selects nothing
🔧 A quick right-click on a monster always starts your auto attack, even if the mouse twitched
⬆️ Holding the left mouse button looks around freely without steering your hero
🔧 In full screen (the game option or F11) the mouse is captured once, so the "To exit full screen" notice no longer pops up every time you turn the camera
🔧 The browser's right-click menu never opens in game any more
⬆️ Melee attacks reach a little further, and monsters never end up standing inside your hero
✨ NPC conversations highlight an option: F picks it, and the arrow keys or mouse wheel move the highlight
⬆️ Quest ! and ? markers over quest givers are much bigger
⬆️ The minimap has N, E, S and W markers and a slimmer frame. The world map updates live as you move, has a full compass and shows zones like AMBERFIELD (Lvl. 1-2)
⬆️ "Destroy" in your bags is now "Salvage"
